item: Row J: a second refresh after the commit that records the merged feed-less tags, so the sibling-verdict step reads no row by id
refs: R170; branch claude/v0-5-plan-j8zvre (PR number at push)
summary: The commit that records the merged feed-less tags expires every row again, and inherit_sibling_verdicts then read each created row with its own SELECT (6,616 on the shipped catalogue, WAL's probe). seed_sources now reads the table once after that commit too, only in a call that created rows: a steady boot merges the same tags every time but creates nothing, so it never runs it. Four tests, two red without (the refresh count: two for a creating call that merged, one for a creating call without merges, none on a steady boot; the per-row reads fall by at least half the created rows), the rows are the same with it off. No timing figure is stated until WAL's independent re-measure.
